name: 爬爬
evolution: 毛毛 → 爬爬 Lv.20 → 化蝶 Lv.35
description: 外壳硬化，缩腹在各种物体的表面爬行。背面艳丽的斑点看似有毒，实际上是鳞翅根。
descriptionEn: Its shell has hardened and it crawls across the surfaces of all kinds of objects with its abdomen tucked in. The bright spots on its back look poisonous, but are in fact the roots of its scale-wings.
